value:
forceAnimatedCurves=none: No curve will be forced in the evaluation graph
forceAnimatedCurves=controller: Curves connected to controller nodes will be forced in the evaluation graph
forceAnimatedCurves=keyed: Keyed static curves, i.e. curves with a single key or multiple keys with the same value, will be forced in the evaluation graph
forceAnimatedCurves=all: All curves will be forced in the evaluation graph
forceAnimatedNodes=none: No node will be forced in the evaluation graph
forceAnimatedNodes=forcedAnimatedAttribute: Nodes with the forced-animated attribute set to true will be forced in the evaluation graph
forcedAnimatedAttributeName=forcedAnimatedAttributeName: Name of the attribute that will force nodes in the evaluation graph
cluster=each: Create a unique cluster for every node
cluster=subgraph: Create a unique cluster for all connected nodes, favoring long clusters
cluster=flood: Create a unique cluster for all connected nodes, favoring big clusters and partitioning speed
